tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i mdos zor gtso gyur gyi mdos kyi rnam gzhag gong ma rnams kyi yig cha bzhin nyams su len tshul sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs bla ma gong ma mang po'i phyag len la mdzad pa'i dbyangs rol 'chams sogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ji ltar 'jug tshul ma tshang ba med pa bzhugs so// mtshan byang mi 'dug kyang 'di ltar min nam snyam/ na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ma hā kā lī de wī karma nā tha sa pā ri wā ra ya/ mig sman ri bo'i spo la thun mtshams kyi/ /gur gum gsar pa 'phos 'dra'i srin po'i gzugs/ /mthong bas bdud dgra'i snying 'gems dpa' bo che/ /bla ma mgon pos nag phyogs bdud las srungs/ /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la bka' babs pa'i bstan srung khyad par can rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor 'di la thun mong dang phul byung gi yig skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs pa las/ 'dir thun mong gi chos skor ram gsal byed kyi yig cha rnams tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos dkar chag tu bsgrigs par mdzad pa la kha skong glegs bam du grags pa'i nang tshan bskang gso'i skor las dam pas mdzad pa'i mdos bskang rgyas pa zur du bya tshul gyi yig cha nged rang gis bsgrigs pa la gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi dbyangs rol cho ga phyag len 'jug tshul thor bkod na/ de yang 'di'i skabs su tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung las/ dam pas mdzad pa'i mdos bskang rgyas pa/ mdos gtor thun mong ba chos nyid dam bskang gso chung ba nag po mchod rten rnams yod kyang / bdag chen rin po che'i gsung las/ mdos bskang rgyas pa dang chos nyid ma gnyis la dam pas mdzad pa'i bskang gso che chung du grags kyi/ nag po mchod rten ni dam pa'i mdos bskang chen mo las sngags 'chang gzungs dpal bas zur du phyung ba yin gsung don la/

rdo rje gdan pa chen po yang de nyid zhal gyis bzhes par snang ste/ mdos bskang chen mo dang chos nyid ma la lung rgyun bzhugs shing / nag po mchod rten la lung rgyun med par bzhed/ mus srad pa ni mdos bskang chen mo/ nag po mchod rten gzhan bskang gso chung ba zhig dang gsum la dam pa'i bskang gso rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum zhes them yig dang gces spras mdzad mod/ deng sang phal cher ni chos de sus byas dang / rang gzhung gang yin gyi rtogs dpyod med par byed mkhan su mang dang dpe cha gang byung 'jigs rngams gang che zhig lag len byed par snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa las kho bos bsgrigs pa 'di ni dam pa'i mdos bskang chen mo la zor mdos su bya tshul tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i dmar chen gtor bzlog nas kha bskangs/ de'i cha lag pho rkyang drag po'i sbyin sreg sa chen gyi gsung la gnyen phul chung pas zin bris su mdzad pa bstod pa dang bcas nag 'gros su bkod/ las bzhi'i bro brdung dam pas mdzad pa la tshig zur cung zad bsgyur ba yin pas/ rje btsun gong mas mdos zor gyi phyag len shin tu rgyas pa dang 'brel zhing / zhar la rten mdos dang mchod mdos kyi rnam bzhag kyang 'thon pas de'i lag len bya tshul sa lo chen po yab sras kyi phyag len dang mthun par bkod na/ thog mar bsham gyi rim pa ni mdos bskang gi yig cha nyid kyi dbu na gsal la/ mdos gdan ri ri rab sogs zan dang 'jim pa 'dam ga yin cing / shing khri rung ba kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pas bzhed pas zhar la 'jag khri rung ba ni lag len khyer bde bar mngon te/ de yang 'jag phon la skud pas bsdams pa'i ri rab kyi gzugs la phyi nas 'bru sna'i zan gzhal ba'i tshul du byugs/ de la ri rab kyi khog dang mthun pa'i chu tshan byugs/ gling bzhi'i gling phran ri bdun rol mtsho lcags ri mar me rnams 'jim pa dang / bshos bu mtheb skyu sogs zan la bcos/

mdung thung dang mda' 'phang rnams ngo ma/ rtse dang bang rim la 'god rgyu'i gzugs 'gros rnams tsa ka li dang / pho gdong mo gdong khram shing rnams shing leb la bri ba'am/ yang na tsa ka li shing la sbyar kyang rung / nam rgyangs rnams rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dbye ba ni 'byor pa dang bstun nas bya/ de dag gi dbyibs rten mchod bzlog gsum gyi dbye ba mdos bskang na shin tu gsal ba bzhin brgyud ldan bla ma'i phyag khrid can gyi skabs su gang babs nyams su blangs/ bris sku zhing khams ma yod na yi dam chos skyong gi mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gnyen mgon lta bu'i dmigs bsal ma gtogs ma byung kyang chog 'on kyang rgya gzhung bod gzhung phal cher gyis phyi rol tshogs gsog gi gtso bo la maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod 'di gsungs pas tshom bu bsham thub na shin tu legs shing / mgon po lha brgyad la de ltar bya tshul gong ma'i gsung bzhin kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i yig cha zhal gsal can yang mchis pas ngos kyis kyang mdos bskang du de dang phyogs mtshungs bkod pa yin zhing / mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab sras kyi phyag len la bskang gtor sogs kyi drung du bshams pa des go chod par mdzad kyang / byung na 'dir ma zad mchod pa'i rigs kun grangs mang zhing rgya che ba rang legs pas maṇ+ḍal gnyis la'ang zhi drag gi mchod pa re mthar bkod na shin tu 'brel chags par sems so/ /ngag 'don gyi rim pa sgrub pa po rnams gral la 'khod la nas bdag bskyed phur pa byed na de'i gser skyems rgyas bsdus gang rung / lam dus byed na sa los mdzad pa'i mgon po'i gser skyems/ gang ltar na'ang / gser skyems nas bden bdar rdzogs pa'i bar zhwa gyon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi rjes su bcom dung btang la bcom rol 'phar ma dang / de bstun las kyi rdo rjes kha ras bcas gser skyems thogs nas 'phar rdzogs pa'i rol mo gsum brdeg len can la/

'chams 'go blangs la 'jam po'i 'khyil 'chams rgyun bzhin dang / gser skyems nam mkhar 'thor 'os pa yod na de bzhin dang / med tshe mdos drung du snod bzhag la 'chams rdzogs mtshams rnams su gser skyems brje thang re phyag len bzhin/ rang rkyang pa sogs shin tu nyung na gser skyems stegs la bkod pa thams cad rdzogs pa'i mthar sa gtsang sar phul/ gang ltar gser skyems rdzogs pa'i chems brdungs la sgang dung rol mo sum brdeg len can/ bden bdar lan gsum byung na mchog tu legs/ 'di'i tshig rigs la rje btsun sa skya pa zhes bris pa ni gdan sa 'di nyid kyi dmigs bsal yin gyi/ gzhan du bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod ces pa 'dis go chod par sems/ rten mchod bzlog gsum gyi mdos gang la'ang mchod mdos zhes pa'i tshig sbyar ba la 'gal ba med par sems te/ rten mdos ni nang rten gyi gras su gsungs pa'i don la sku rten dang mchod rdzas gnyis ka yin cing / mchod mdos ni sgra de sor bzhag bzlog mdos ni mchod pa'i lhag ma zor rdzas su byin gyi brlabs pa yin pas mdos thams cad la mchod pa zhes spyi khyab tu 'jug par mngon no/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma'i dbyangs rol ni phyag len bzhin/ bdag bskyed phur pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring yin na byin 'bebs dgos stabs bde mchog gtor bsngo rdzogs pa'i rjes su gser skyems nas sngon 'gro gtor ma'i bar byas la mgon po'i mdun bskyed la 'jug phur chung dang kye rdor la gong bkod bzhin/ gnas yo byin brlabs grub nas dkar cha byed tshe de bzhin/ bdag bskyed nas yi dam gyi gtor bsngo rdzogs pa'i bar/ kyai rdor ltar na mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod kyi phyag len ni/ phur pa ltar na'ang de skabs su ji ltar byed pa'i phyag len bzhin/ chos skyong gi mdun bskyed ni/ mdos gzhung ji lta ba bzhin la/ /drug cu pa'i bskyed chog 'di mdun bskyed spyir btang yin pas 'di'i dmigs bsal ltar na dbus dang mdun rtsibs la mgon po dang yum chen lha mo/

bskyed pa'i hūm̐ dang bh+yo'i sgra sgrogs pa zhes pa'i rjes su mgon po'i thugs ka nas yaṃ/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ mdun du 'phros pa las rtsibs gnyis par yaṃ las nag po sogs gsum par maṃ las nag mo sogs/ yab las tri tri dang yum las bh+yo 'phros pa las rtsibs lhag ma gsum la pu tra ming sring bskyed pa yin cing / gzhan yang hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ bh+rūṃ yaṃ maṃ zhes lcam dral zangs gri can las mgon lnga rnams kyi sa bon brjod dgos dang dam bzhag rang gtor sngags la zangs gri can med pa ni bsdu na mgon po dang ma mo'i bod pa'i nang du 'thus par sems so/ /chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor bsngo'i rim pa byed tshul kyang de nang na gsal/ bshags pa tshigs lhug ma gsum sogs skabs su gang babs/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs kyi/ oṃ badz+ra nas gang bar gyur gyi bar/ sngags drug phyag drug rdzogs pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur gyi rjes su/ oṃ sarba nas khaṃ gi swāhā'i bar lan gcig de nas dpon slob rnams bzhengs la slob dpon gyis rdor dril g.yab dar thogs gzhan rnams kyis rnga rol rkang gling dung sogs 'bud dkrol dang / dur khrod nag po'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i mgon spos sam/ gu gul sha chen sogs kyi dud pa sbyar la/ dad ring gi byin 'bebs dang / thog mar 'phar chung gsum la dril gsil/ rol mo dang bstun pa'i rnga yog phog mtshams rnams su dar g.yab re/ de nas rol mo kha slong pa'i chung ba rnams la dril gsil g.yab dar bzhag 'phar chen rnams la dril gsil dang rnga yog phog mtshams su g.yab dar re/ spyan 'dren gyi rol mo rnams ma rdzogs par 'phar yod med gang la'ang dril gsil dang g.yab dar bya tshul des rigs 'gre sbyar la/ byon skyems dang rdo rje thugs ka dang dril gsil las g.yab dar mi dgos/ hūm̐ dad pa nas/ bsgral du gsol gyi bar dbyangs rol dang 'dur ma sogs gtong tshul phyag len bzhin/

hūm̐ ngo zhes 'dren bcug pa'i rdo rje 'chang sh+lau ka gcig la bswo ring gi bu dbyangs gnas 'dir la tshig rol/ hūm̐ ngo zhes 'dren bcug pas bdag ni sh+lau ka gcig la dbyangs de nyid/ nag po 'khor bcas la tshig rol gyi rjes su chems brdung gi mthar gsum brdeg len can ro bcud rgyan ldan sh+lau ka gcig la tshig rol gyi mthar chems brdung gsum brdeg len bcas rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod ni 'og nas 'byung bas 'dir mi bya bar/ hūm̐ 'dren bcug pas dpal ldan mgon po nas/ stsal du gsol gyi bar dang / hūm̐ 'dren bcug pas gzhan yang nas/ mdzod kyi bar dang / de las nas/ gsol gyi bar gsum la rang dbyangs rol mo/ yan lag nas/ shangs la 'bul gyi bar mchod dbyangs rol mo/ mi rta nas gnyen po srung gi rjes su tshig rol/ gtum chen nyi ma sh+lau ka gcig la rdo rje drag chen ma'i dbyangs ring rol mo nyer gcig ma/ sngon gyi bskal pa nas/ gsol gyi rjes su gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa byas la rnga rol bzhag nas/ mdos gtan ri rab kyi steng dang mtha'i gtor ma dang mtheb kyu rnams mgon po 'khor bcas la phul bar bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mthar se gol dang bcas shā sa na nyer gcig gis bsngos/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ de'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba'i nang mchod/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bskang rdzas kyi mchod gtor rgya chen po 'di bzhes la nas/ rgya chen po mdzad du gsol gyi bar phrin bcol gsung rgyun bzhin/ nag po chen po sh+lau ka gcig la hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar ba'i 'khril mchod ma'i dbyangs dang gsum brdeg len can/ bzhes shig 'bul lo la tshig rol/ rdo rje drag chen ma'i dbyangs rol chos nyid ma bzhin/ mngon spyod drag po la tshig rol/

hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar ba'i dur khrod chen po nas/ 'gyu'i bar rab brjid dpa' bo'i 'dur gdangs rol mo/ nag po khyod ni la tshig rol/ hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar/ dpal ldan chos skyong sh+lau ka gcig la stong nyid ma'i dbu dbyangs rol mo/ gzhan don byams pa'i la tshig rol/ dus gsum bde gshegs ma/ rnam dag tshogs gtor ma/ mdzes pa'i spu sdug ma rnams la rang dbyangs rol mo/ mi nag rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ mdos rdzogs mtshams tshig rol dgra dang 'byung po la tshig rol/ hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar/ dur khrod chen po sh+lau ka gcig la nag po mi zan ma'i dbyangs rol/ ci bcol las la tshig rol/ hūm̐ 'dren bcug pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag sh+lau ka gcig la yang dag don du'i dbyangs gsum brdeg len med/ nag po chen po la tshig rol mi 'gyur ma la rang dbyangs rol mo/ skong gyur la tshig rol/ dpal ldan lha mo sh+lau ka gcig la gzhan yang ma 'bring po nam gru ma'i dbyangs rol/ bcol ba'i phrin las la tshig rol/ ma hā kā la la sh+lau ka gcig la hūm̐ ngo' 'ang zhes sbyar ba'i bdud rgyal bskul gyi dbyangs rol dang rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ nag po chen po sh+lau ka gcig la hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar ba'i chos nyid ma'i rnam dag tshogs gtor ma'i dbyangs rol/ bcol pa'i phrin las la tshig rol/ hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar ba'i zhe sdang me 'bar sh+lau ka gcig la srin thung ma'i dbyangs rol/ rdul bzhin la tshig rol/ 'dod chags khrag mtsho la de ltar/ tshar gcod ma'i dbyangs rol/ dgra bgegs brlag pa la tshig rol/ mgon po'i bka' nyan sh+lau ka gcig la dpal ldan gru 'dzin ma'i dbyangs rol/ de 'phros rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ dam can ming sring rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ bskang 'os sh+lau ka gcig la gang thugs ma thung ba/ rnal 'byor dgra lha rdzogs mtshams/ 'dod pa sgrub la tshig rol/ gzhan yang rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ mthu stobs chen po'i la tshig rol/ khyed thugs la hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar ba'i he ru ka'i dbyangs dang /

bla med ma'i rol mo chems brdung med pa rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ dpal ldan mgon po la rang dbyangs rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ dpal ldan chos skyong la rang dbyangs rdzogs mtshams dgu brdung gnyis/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po sogs la rol mo len mtshams rnams rnga shon bzhin/ rdzogs mtshams chems brdung dang drag dung / kyai bos so sh+lau ka gcig dang tshig rkang lnga la dbyangs 'khor gsum brdeg len can/ chos skyong mgon po'i rjes kyi rol mo len lugs chos nyid ma bzhin bzlog dbyangs bcas bzlog pa rdzogs nas chems brdung gsum brdeg len can/ sngags dbyangs sogs rgyun bskang bzhin bya dgos pas/ de dag gdan sa 'di ka'i dus gtor chen mo la sbyor tshul dang / gzhan bskang gso rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la sbyor tshul mdos bskang rkyang pa bya tshul rnams rim pa bzhin brjod na/ nyer drug la gtor bsngo'i bshags pa gcig mdos bskang spyan 'dren dur bdag dang las mkhan rdzogs pa'i chems brdung gi mthar gsum brdeg len can/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i mthar gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ mthu stobs chen po'i bar gong bzhin/ bstan srung rgya mtsho nas rtsa brgyud bla ma rdzogs pa'i bar mdos bskang gi bshags pa khyed thugs ma/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma dbyangs bcas gcig bskang gsar gyi phrin bcol de'i bzlog pa'i rjes su chems brdung mi byed par gsum brdeg len can/ mdos bskang gi bshags pa dpal ldan mgon po bka' bsgo dpal ldan chos skyong nas/ kyai bos rdzogs pa'i bar mdos bskang bzhin/ sngags dbyangs sngon 'gro'i nyer drug gi bstod pa/ nyer bdun la mdos bskang gi spyan 'dren rdzogs nas chems brdung mi byed par de wī ko ṭa sogs rgyun bzhin la spyan 'dren dang / byon skyems kyi chems brdung so so'i mthar gsum brdeg len can rol bskor sogs byed tshul gong bzhin/

mdos bskang rdzogs nas gzhan yang ma ring mo nas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i rjes su mdos bskang gi bshags pa/ khyed thugs ma/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma dbyangs bcas gcig bshags pa dpal ldan mgon po ma/ bka' bsgo/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub myur du stsol gyi rjes su dgu brdung gcig dpal ldan mgon po sogs rnga shon bcas/ chems brdung rdzogs nas gsum brdeg 'phar ma/ kyai bos ma ma dbyangs bu dbyangs bskul nas 'dur ma mthar phyin mdzod la tshig rol gyi rjes su sngags dbyangs sogs bstod pa srin gzugs ma'i dbyangs sde tshan/ nyer brgyad la mdos bskang rdzogs nas lha mo'i sgos bskang nas mdos bskang gi kyai bos rdzogs pa'i bar nyer bdun bzhin la 'dod pa'i dngos grub myur du sgrubs zhes pa dang rol mo blangs nas gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ kyai bos ma la nyer drug bzhin sngon tshe ma'i sde tshan/ nyer dgu la mdos bskang rdzogs nas lha mo'i sgos bskang nas bzung dgu gtor tshang ma dang / mdos bskang gi bshags pa bka' bsgo rdzogs pa'i bar btang tshul nyer brgyad bzhin la rnga shon med pas/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyi mthar dgu brdung gnyis kyai bos dang bzlog pa bzhag nas bstod pa gang thugs ma'i sde tshan/ gnam gang la phur chung gtor bsngo dang thugs dam ma shur ma la bskang gsar sbyar nas/ gtong tshul phyag len bzhin la bstod pa bcas/ phur pa'i tshogs 'khor bsdus pa/ lhag ma gtor 'bul sogs rgyun bzhin no/ /yang 'di thugs dam ma 'og dbyangs yod med dang / sbrel nas bya tshul la mdos bskang gi spyan 'dren rdzogs nas gang gi rang bzhin sogs spyan 'dren tshang ma'i mtha' dang byon skyems kyi mtha'i chems brdung gi rjes su gsum brdeg bya tshul sogs gong bzhin/ mdos bskang rdzogs mtshams gzhan yang ma nas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bar/ ༈ /'go dbyangs yin na mdos bskang gi bshags pa khyed thugs ma/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma/

yang mdos bskang gi bshags pa dpal ldan ma nas bzlog pa rdzogs pa'i bar/ shur ma yin na sa skya'i rje btsun ma'i rjes su bshags pa gnyis man chad gong bzhin/ yang bskang gsar rkyang pa la sbyor na/ mdos bskang gi spyan 'dren gyi rjes su bskang gsar gyi spyan 'dren sbyar la rol mo gsum brdeg sogs khyad par bya tshul rnams gong bzhin/ mdos bskang rdzogs mtshams bstan srung rgya mtsho nas bzlog pa rdzogs pa'i bar byas la/ gsum brdeg len can/ mdos bskang gi bshags pa nas bzlog pa rdzogs pa'i bar/ yang sku dang gsung thugs ma la sbyor na mdos bskang gi spyan 'dren rdzogs nas/ gang gi rang bzhin sogs shur ma bskang gsar bzhin dang / mdos bskang rdzogs nas sku dang gsung thugs la rol mo yod med gang rigs chems brdung med pa/ mdos bskang gi bshags pa man 'dra zhing spyi bstabs dbyangs med/ yang mdos bskang rkyang pa byed na gser skyems nas bdag bskyed gang rung rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ mdos la bkod pa'i gtor ma rnams yi dam gang rung gi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ lha brgyad kyi mdun bskyed zor bskyed sogs gnas gsum byin brlabs nas/ sa mā dzaḥ'i bar bya/ mdos bskang gi spyan 'dren byon skyems kyi rol bskor rdzogs nas mchod pa dang dam bzhag gtor bsngo/ yang phyi mchod nang mchod phrin bcol bcas gtor bsngo bzhin la/ lha mo'i gtor sngags kyi rjes su las mgon kyang mthud/ yig brgya mgo gnon lcam dral las mkhan gyi sngags rnams bzlas nas mchod 'bul/ phrin bcol bshags pa byas la/ mdos sngags drug phyag drug gi byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas la nas/ bzlog pa rdzogs pa'i bar bya/ bstod pa ma skyes kha klong ma/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di bsgrub par mdzod kyi rjes su rdor glu sogs spyi bstabs kyi tshig hūm̐ bh+yoḥdapal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la ye nas/

srog gcod nag po che'i bar srog gzugs ma bzhin sh+lau ka gcig la rang dbyangs bcas/ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong nas/ las mkhan 'khor bcas kyi bar/ 'dir gshegs sogs rgyun bzhin no/ /de nas gong khros liṅga bsgral mchod kyi thad du slebs pa dang / hom ling gi 'khor lo 'bru nag gi steng du bzhag gtor ma gru gsum dang chu gnyis nyer mchod kyis bskor/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs ba nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'i bar sbyin sreg gi yi ge bzhin mchod pa bsangs sbyangs nas/ nang du'i bar kyai rdor mdun bskyed bzhin la hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil zhes tshig bsgyur/ 'gor oṃ dang / mjug tu āḥhūm̐/ bar du badz+ra dang mchod pa so so'i sngags bcug pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'bul tshul sbyin sreg bzhin/ gtor ma byin brlabs kyai rdor sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar rdor thal dang bcas gtor ma tshar gsum sogs 'bul/ srin gzugs ma sh+lau ka gcig la dril gsil shur ma/ dgug gzhug dang lha dbye drug cu pa bzhin la dgra bo thams cad ces dang / 'khor lo la bkod pa'i ming yig 'di la mchis par gyur cig ces sbyar zhing / lha dbye'i chems brdung gi mtha'i rol mo la'ang rgyun bzhin slob dpon gyis 'chams tshul bcas rnga rol bzhag la bkug pa'i dgra bo rnams sarba sha truṃ la thim par bsam/ skabs 'dir mchod gtor ma phul kyang chog sbyin sreg nas byung ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa sarba sha truṃ di na me ke na mā ra ya brgya rtsa/ shā sa na drug cu bzla'o/ /'di tshugs nyin ma gtogs mi dgos/ skabs 'dir gung gseng lta bu'i bar zhig bzhag nas las kyi rdo rjes ling steb dang 'jug tshul sogs sbyin sreg gi yi ge bzhin byas nas hom ling dgra bgegs kyi liṅga so so snod gcig tu bkod pa dang /

bstabs ling dgra bgegs liṅga thun mong ba zor mdun du bzhag pa de nyid slob dpon gyi drung du rkang pa gtor ma ngos dang mgo bo slob dpon la phyogs par bstabs ling gi snod 'og dang hom ling steng du bzhag nas 'brub khung bskyed chog nas bzung lha dbye'i bar byas la hom ling gdong ras bkab mdos 'og tu bzhag sbyin sreg ma ran bar de bzhin bya/ bstabs ling la de man gyi bsgral mchod yongs rdzogs bya dgos pas gang ltar yang mdos gzhung nas 'byung ba'i dgug gzhug lan gsum gyi phyag rgya bya tshul phyag len bzhin dang lha dbye la thun gyis brabs par yi ge rnying ma rnams su gsungs pa/ 'das pa'i nus pa 'bru gsum gyi rnam par rang la bsdu tshar ba de bzhin/ dmod bskul la rdo rje g.yab dar bcas thogs nas rol mo chems brdung la shā sa na dang bod rbad bsad gsum bzlas la/ shā sa na rdzogs mtshams mo'i sngags gsum rdzogs mtshams/ pho'i sngags gsum rdzogs mtshams rnams su g.yab dar ling steng du brdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdor dril thogs la 'chams tshul dang rol mo gsung rgyun ltar na sbraṃ sbraṃ the ba'i bdun brdung gcig don 'di dgu brdung du 'gro/ gsum brdung gnyis che gcig rnga phyir brdung dpang gzugs kyi dbyangs dang bcas/ dkon mchog nas/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi bar dal/ de nas brel/ nus pa nyams par gyis kyi mthar rol mo gong bzhin/ hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar ba'i 'di'i spyi bo nas phrol la thong gi bar dal/ tshe srog nas brel/ myur du sgrub kyi mthar rol mo gong bzhin gyi rjes su chems brdung rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu drag dkrol/ sngags dang dmod pa sogs ci yang mi dgos/ rol mo gsum brdeg len can dang bstun pa'i dril gsil byas la bzhag phur pa bskyed chog la/ slob dpon gyi g.yon pas phur pa rang la zhal phyogs par bzung / g.yas pas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul byas la/

bsangs sbyangs dang bskyed tshig rdzogs nas shā sa na gsum/ ye dhar dang phur sngags tshar gcig mnga' gsol tshar gsum gyi dang po la khrag gnyis pa la chang / gsum pa la yungs dkar phur par gtor/ rnga brdung la khros pa'i gzugs ldan sh+lau ka gsum la chos nyid ma'i bzlog dbyangs bcug nas sh+lau ka gnyis rdzogs mtshams so sor dgu brdung 'then rkang can sogs rol mo yang de bzhin dang / slob dpon gyis phur pa thogs pas 'chams tshul/ gsum pa rdzogs nas gsum brdeg 'then rkang dgu brdung sogs mi byed par dbyangs rdzogs pa'i ya zhes pa'i mthar rol mo blangs la che gcig dgu brdung 'then rkang can dal ba gsum la slob dpon gyis rang gi snying thad nas phur rtse phyir bstan la rol mo dang bstun par sgril/ 'bring po dgu la ling thog tu sgril/ myur ba dgu la de'i snying gar ma reg tsam bsgril nas/ shā sa na/ lha mo/ las mgon gyi bsad sngags rnams bzlas nas mthar chems brdung la phur rtse ling khog na 'khor lo'i bla dar gang yod de la nem gyis gtsugs/ rnam shes spar ba'i dmigs pa bsgom/ rnam par shes pa hūm̐ yig phur dbal dang khong par brgyud dbu gtsug nas 'thon pa rjes chags kyi dmigs pas dag zhing du spor ba'i tshe phur pa snying ga nas 'don pa dang rtse gyen bstan gang yang mi dgos par/ lag pa g.yon pas phur bu bzung g.yas pas nyer mchod lnga phyag rgya dang bcas ngag tu 'bru gsum thog mthar sbyar zhing badz+ra dang mchod sngags sbyar ba brjod/ sems kyis dgra bgegs kyi shes pa he ru kar gyur pa la dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod pa dang bcas dag zhing du spyan drangs par bsams la/ phaṭa brjod cing mig dang gdong gyen la blta/ de ltar dmigs pa ji ltar rigs pa bsgoms tshar ba'i rjes su phur pa bton la/ mgon po'i yig rnying phur bskul rgyas pa rnams su gnas so la phur ling dang mā ra ya btags nas 'debs par gsungs pas spyi bo/

mig gnyis/ rna ba gnyis/ sna lce mgrin pa/ lag mthil gnyis/ rkang mthel gnyis/ snying ga'i phur shul/ lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams su btab la phur pa bsdus lag pa g.yon pas thun snod bzung / g.yas pas thog mar skam thun/ de nas rlon thun gyis brab/ gri gug gis rkang mgo gnyis nas bzung spyi bo'i bar dum bur btubs nas drag dung lan gnyis 'bud pa sogs rgyun gyi phyag len bzhin rol mo gsum brdeg len can byas la bzhag bsgral mchod kyi rol tshig 'di rnams bdag chen rdo rje 'chang sogs kyi phyag len yin par sems/ de nas zhwa phud las kyi rdo rje langs te mdos gtor la kha phyogs par ling snod bzung / dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje 'dzin dang nas/ byin brlabs nas kyi bar rnga brdung bzhag pa'i baiḍūr+ya sngon po'i dbyangs/ drin chen ma la rang dbyangs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dper na kha raṃ khā hi zhes pa las med kyang / 'don char khā hi kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes sbyar la rdzogs pa dang rol mo chems brdung ma hā rak+ta sogs kyi sngags dang / shā sa na tshar gcig brjod/ ling ro'i phud nas gtor bsngo dang bskang ba'i gtor ma la cung zad phul/ byings la 'og gi gsol kha bya/ chems brdung rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can/ gnas yo byin brlabs sngon 'gro'i bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi tshig rigs rnams gdan sa 'dir rang gi 'don cha sa lo'i gsung rgyun bzhin yin pas de bzhin dbyangs rol bcas byas la/ zhwa gyon las kyi rdo rjes gsol kha'i chas mdos gzhung bzhin bshams la/ dpon slob rnams kyis rnga brdung dang bcas mgon po'i mtshan gsol sh+lau ka gnyis la 'jam rdor ma'i dbyangs mjug brel ba rol mo bcas gus pa'i tshul gyi nas gsol gyi bar la 'dur gdangs mjug tu gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa 'di'i tshig bsgyur la/ mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /'dod don mthun pa'i rkyen rnams sgrub pa dang /

/thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sbyar gsol kha tshigs lhug la rnga rol bzhag dang po gnod byed dgra gegs nas chems brdung / shā sa na gcig gnyis pa'i gdong chen gyi nas chems brdung / oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī ka li badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa ka li yak+ṣi ṇi/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha ṭa/ ru lu rak+ṣa si/ sa pa ri wā ra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha truṃ bighan ཱna mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gcig gsum pa'i bdag cag gi nas rol mo/ shā sa na tshar gcig de 'dra ba lan gsum dgos tshul yig cha na shin tu gsal yang lag len pa rnams tshar gsum po des go chod par byed pa ltar na tshar re la gtor theb gsum char 'debs par mngon zhing / de ltar na de 'dra ba lan gsum byed tshe dum bu nyi shu rtsa bdun du 'gro la/ gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar na mgon po la gcig lha mo sogs la gcig 'dod gsol la gcig ste/ gsol kha yongs rdzogs tshar gsum la dum bu dgur 'gyur ba yin no gong ltar/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i mthar gsum brdeg len can/ gsol kha'i chems brdung thams cad la slob dpon gyis dril gsil sgang dung dang mi rkang gdangs gcig ma re/ rang yi dam gnas 'gyur gyi rjes su chems brdung dang dgu brdung gnyis/ rnga phyir brdung dang bcas zor rdzas byin brlabs kyi dgu brdung rdzogs nas rnga rol bzhag shā sa na phreng 'khor/ shrī ya de wī drug cu pa'i gsol kha bzhin lnga bcu/ oṃ ma hā kā la ru pa sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa nyer lnga/ las mgon mo'i bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel ba nyer lnga/ pho'i bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel ba nyer lnga/ thun sngags nyer lnga rnams bzla rgyu la shā sa na shib bu dang / lha mo man chad bsgrigs 'don/ dam tshig chen po'i 'chams dbyangs kyi rol mo/ rkang gling g.yab dar bcas bcom/ hūm̐ ngo bh+yoḥwa ya dur khrod 'bar ba'i nas/ phob cig bar dbyangs/ mtshams 'dir rol mo/ yang hūm̐ ngo bh+yo wa ya skam zor nas mdzod cig bar dbyangs rol/

yang hūm̐ ngo bh+yoḥwa ya rlon zor nas mdzod cig bar dbyangs dang tshig lhad kyi rol mo lan dang / 'then rkang gsum rdzogs nas dgu brdung gcig bzlog rol bzhin/ bdag gi gtor zor 'dur shur gang rigs/ las rnams thams cad la tshig rol dgu brdung / phyogs skyong bcu bskul la shar nas 'og gi bar phyogs re re bzhin rdzogs mtshams dgu brdung rdzogs nas chos skyong mgon po sogs mdos bskang gi gnad bskul dang / chos nyid ma'i bzlog rol blangs la/ lha chen dpal 'bar gyi bzlog pa la chos nyid ma'i dbyangs rol yongs rdzogs bcug nas mjug gi chems brdung bzhag gang gi dur khrod nas phyogs skyong bcu bskul ma rdzogs bar rkang gling / g.yab dar bzlog pa tshugs nas rnga rol gyi go chod/ khyad par gyi bzlog pa la mtshams so sor hūm̐ 'dren rnams kyang yongs rdzogs sbyar/ thams cad rdzogs nas tshig rol dgu brdung chems/ bzlog dung slob dpon gyi dril gsil mdos gtor rnams la yungs dkar gyis brab/ mthar gsum brdeg len can/ tshogs dang lhag ma kyai rdor ltar na nged rang gis brtsams pa'i dam tshig bskang gso'i phyag deb bzhin la zhal gyi sngags ring sogs dmigs bsal rnams bzhag spyi bstabs dang mjug chog kyai rdor mdun bskyed la dgos pa rnams phyag len bzhin/ sang 'phen rgyu'i do nub khyad par gyi bzlog pa rdzogs nas gnas de nyid dam de dang ha cang mi ring ba'i phyogs zhig tu byung na slob dpon mdun bskyed la rgyab bstan dgos pa mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i sbyin sreg gi gzhung rnams na shin tu gsal yang 'dir ni kha lhor phyogs pa'i drung du sbyin sreg gi yo byad rnams gzhung bzhin bsham/ lha brgyad kyi tshoms bu'i drung du ka li sogs snod ji ltar rigs pa 'bru nag gis bkang ba la spos ring spar nas gzugs/ slob dpon drag chas su zhugs/ gzhan rnams kyis rnga rol hom ling sogs yo byad rnams thogs te sbyin sreg gi sar phyin la liṅga slob dpon gyi drung du bzhag pa'i mthar dpon slob rnams zhwa gyon langs nas bskor dgug gzhug nas brtsams te bsgral mchod drug cu pa bzhin byas la phyi nang gsang ba ma mi byed par chems brdung rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can/

ja yod na btang / shā sa na bzla bzhin pas me sbar thab khung bsangs sbyangs nas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan gyi bar sbyin sreg bzhin so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i ma hā rak+ta sa mu dra sogs bdud rtsi lnga mchod nas 'byung ba'i drag mchod kyi sngags la ma hā rak+ta sa mu dra pā d+yaṃ zhes kyang sbyar mthar mchod rol gur drag bzhin la sgang dung dang rkang gling gdangs gcig la/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'i nang mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sh+lau ka gcig la dril gsil/ dgra ling gi dum bu nas gsum dang / oṃ ag+na ye sogs gzhung bzhin/ bgegs kyi shog ling zan ling bla shing dum bu bcas nas gsum dang / sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las sarba bigh+nan/ drag po'i rdzas rnams nas gsum re phul la sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las sarba sha truṃ bigh+nan zhes sbyar/ me lha 'bar ba'i nas 'phros pa'i bar gzhung bzhin la mdun bskyed kyi ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod la bcom dung btang / slob dpon gyis dril gsil g.yab dar dang / gzhan rnams kyis bswo ring gi bcom rol rkang gling g.yab dar dbyangs dang bcas pas/ rdo rje 'chang gi sh+lau ka gcig la bswo ring gi dbyangs dang rol mo nyis brdeg 'phar ma'i mthar chems brdung sngags bcas rkang gling g.yab dar/ mjug tu rol mo gsum brdeg len can/ rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la bzhag rol mo nyis brdeg 'phar ma chems brdung sogs dang bstun las kyi rdo rje lha brgyad maṇ+ḍal tshom bu la phyag gsum phul la kha ras lag lcibs dang bcas pas snod nas nag gis bkang ba spos rengs dang bcas pa mdun bskyed kyi sbyin sreg gzhan ltar na slob dpon gyi rgyab nas phul/ slob dpon gyis lag pa gnyis kas phrag pa g.yas phyogs nas blangs/ mdun bskyed zhal sprod ltar na mdun nas 'bul len bya/ spos rengs kyi rtse mo nas cung zad bcad snod kyi nas 'bru kha shas dang bcas pa thab nang du phul la/

oṃ e h+ye hi nas dri sh+ya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ snod nas bcas pa dang spos kyi 'phro me ma sbar bar thab drung du steng khar bzhag dpon slob thams cad kyis mgo thod kyi phyag rgya gos kyi dbyibs su bcas la/ nag po khyod kyi sogs/ dam bzhag dang gnas gsum byin brlab/ drag mchod byin brlabs drug cu pa'i mgo bzhin la/ ma hā mu rak+ta sa mu dra sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ bcom dung btang la sum brdeg gi bcom rol bsdus pa/ bsangs sogs kyi 'gor byed pa bzhin chem brdung la rkang gling bcas/ mgon po 'khor dang nas stsol gyi bar/ rang dbyangs rol mo dang / myos byed stong gi nas/ dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang / /phyogs skyong bcu yi tshogs la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gi sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra/ ma hā gu h+ya a mṛ ta sa mu dra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa'i rjes su nyis brdeg 'phar ma blangs la/ srin gzugs ma la dbyangs bu dbyangs dam nyams dgra bo'i srog gcod nag po/ zhes pa'i rjes su dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod ces sbyar la sum brdeg len can bsdus pa byas la bzhag ja yod na btang / shā sa na bzla bzhin pas/ dgra ling nas lan nyi shu/ bgegs ling dang drag rdzas nas de mtshungs re phul pa'i sde tshan so so'i dang po rdzogs mthar sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnyis pa rdzogs mthar sarba bigh+nan༞ gsum pa rdzogs mthar sarba sha truṃ bigh+nan༞ sbyar la khyon shā sa na drug cus phul/ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sngon 'gro'i ma hā rak+ta sogs phyi mchod/ drag rol rkang gling bcas/ mtshan sngags 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ gtor ma byin brlabs kyai rdor sogs spyi bzhin/ rdor thal se gol bcas shā sa na nyer gcig in+da dza ma nas phaṭa swāhā'i bar gsum/

ja yod na btang / bcom dung dang bcom rol nyis brdeg 'phar ma blangs la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i la sngon tshe ma'i dbyangs rol/ sna tshogs gzugs nas bdag bstod do'i bar 'dur shur gang rigs hūm̐ 'dren dang bcas nag po'i bka' yi sh+lau ka gcig la bskang gsar spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs rol/ de phyin 'dur shur gang rigs/ bzlog pa dang la rol mo blangs la/ sdang dgra nas brlag par mdzod bar la sangs rgyas bstan srung ma'i phrin bcol mjug bzhin/ bsgrub par mdzod kyi rjes su sum brdeg len can la byas la bzhag hoḥbla ma rdo rje slob dpon nas 'bras bu mchis par mdzod cig gi rjes su/ drag rol dang drag dung gi mthar 'jog mtshams gur drag mchod rol bzhin/ he ru ka'i yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang tshigs bcad lhug gnyis kas bzod gsol bya/ khyed kyis sems can sh+lau ka gcig gi rjes su badz+ra muḥ thab nang gi gtso bo'i ye shes pa mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo la thim zhes dang / gong gi spos spar la 'bru snod la btsugs pa slob dpon gyis bzung / las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la phyag gsum btsal la/ mdun rgyab gang rung nas blangs te/ 'bru nag nas mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i tshom bu la gtor/ spos dang snod byings sngar shul du bzhag gtso bo'i dam tshig pa dang 'khor rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur/ ces brjod la ling ro sogs bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin lan gsum phul/ gtor ma la a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i nang du gtor ma sha khrag rus pa'i phung po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ spyir bstan pa dang sogs drug cu pa'i gsol kha'i phrin bcol bya/ bdag gi don dang sogs kyis gshegs gsol byas nas sbyin sreg phyi rol du byas pa yin tshe sgrub khang du log

gang ltar na'ang tshogs spyi bstabs sogs gong bzhin bya'o/ /mdos zor 'phen nyin kye bso dang lha chen dpal 'bar gyi bzlog pa bzhag la/ bka' bsgo bzlog dung rdzogs nas sngags dbyangs sogs bstod pa la btsan 'jus/ khyad par gyi bzlog pa rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can byas la tshogs byin rlabs nas tshogs phud 'bul ba'i bar/ mdos gtor zhal bsgyur gzhung bzhin brjod/ mdos zor ling snod kyi gdan rnams bsubs nas/ mdos kyi mtha' la spungs/ thog mar skam zor/ de nas rlon zor/ de nas gtor mdos rnams sgo phyogs la zhal bsgyur/ dkar lam 'then/ slob dpon drag chas su zhugs te ban phur thogs/ gzhan rnams kyi rnga rol rkang gling sogs nyer mkho du dgos rnams mdos gzhung bzhin chas la langs nas bcom rol/ sum brdeg len can 'phar med rkang gling g.yab dar bcas dus gsum rgyal ba ma'i dbyangs rol drug cu pa bzhin/ hūm̐ bh+yo dpal ldan mgon po nas 'dur shur gang rung / thog gi zor 'debs la tshig rol dgu brdung gi mthar sum rdung gi mu nas phyi rol ji ltar rigs par zor mdos rnams gong bzhin bsgrig 'bul gtor phud chang bcas stegs mtho bar bzhag nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug 'chams dang rol mo drug cu pa'i mon bu pu tra'i 'gor byed pa ji lta ba bzhin/ lcam dral bka' bstod mon bu pu tra'i dbyangs 'khor gsum rol mo bcas/ mon bu bha ṭa nas 'dur shur gang rung / rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzod kyi rjes su spyi bstabs drug cu pa bzhin/ chems brdung gi rigs la gtor sngags shā sa na tshar gsum/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang 'bru gsum gyis phyi nang gi mchod pa/ spyir bstan pa dang sogs drug cu pa'i gsol kha'i phrin bcol/ chem brdung rdzogs nas rol mo gsum brdeg len can gong du bzhag pa'i kyai bos ma dbyangs skor gnyis kyi rjes ma'i gsum brdeg len can rdzogs nas/

mdos kyi gnad bskul chos skyong mgon po sogs dang gong du bzhag pa'i lha chen dpal 'bar gyi dbyangs rol rnams rdzogs nas gsum gyi ngang nas/ mdos gtor stegs ji ltar rigs pa gong bzhin bsgrigs nas bse mgon lha zhal pu tra'i drag bskul rnams phyag len rdzogs nas rol mo gong bzhin dang bcas mdos 'phen sar slebs pa dang / 'chams rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can byas la bzhag gser skyems dpang gzugs zor lam dbye ba rnams drug cu pa bzhin/ pho nya rnga bskul gyi dbyangs rol phyag len bzhin la mi nag gi rol mo nyis brdeg len can rdzogs nas/ sbram 1 2 3 dgu brdung gcig bzlog pa bzhin/ gaṇ+ḍe las sprul nas/ thal ba rdul du rlog la tshig rol dgu brdung / ru 'dren bskul gyi ring la slob dpon mda' gzhu thogs nas mdos zor dang nye bar 'gro tshul phur bzlog bzhin/ bud med bskul gyi bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo zhes pa dang gzhu rgyud dang stong sbyar/ mjug gi tshig rol dgu brdung rdzogs nas rol skor la 'chams tshul yang phur bzlog bzhin/ chems brdung gi ring la shā sa na bzla bzhin pas/ mda' zor/ rwa zor/ khrag zor/ gyo zor/ kong zor/ rdo zor/ gtor zor rnams rgyang ring du 'phen/ de nas pad+ma sogs kyi me phung chen po spar la mdos lag tu theg pa'am ma theg na rol bskor gyi ring la lag gnyis khro bo'i sdigs mdzub bcas 'chams tshul mda' zor gyi sngon 'gro bzhin/ chems brdung shā sa na/ shrī ya de wī/ las mgon gyi bod rbad bsad gsum/ thun sngags bha ya na rnams bzlas nas hūm̐ stobs ldan zhes pa nas/ mdzad nas kyi bar gzhung bzhin la rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa gdung brgyud bu slob lha sde mi sde dpal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs rbad 'dre rbad gtong mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig tsam gyis nas mdzod cig gi bar gzhung bzhin/

gzhan du ni mdzad nas kyi rjes su/ spyir bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams dang / khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i man chad gong bzhin brjod la/ slob dpon dang las kyi rdo rje sogs mi mang pos mdos btegs nas me dpung gi dbus su rtse theb phyogs la bstan nas brdab/ de dag gi dmigs pa gzhung bzhin bsgom/ brdab phod logs pa sa la brdab/ bsrung 'khor bsgom phyi mig mi lta bar log la sgrub khang gi nye 'khor ji ltar rigs par/ ja yod na btang / snod rnams kha phub nas las bzhi'i bro rdung / slob dpon gyis bskul la/ bcom ldan mi bskyod nas/ sna tshogs sgrub kyi bar bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi rak+ta'i mchod yon sogs la byed pa'i gdangs/ las bzhi'i tshig dngos la dbyangs so so gsham gsal bzhin/ shā sa na sngags dbyangs phyag len bzhin la cung zad brel ba 'dod gsol spel tshig rnams 'dur shur gang rigs bzhin la slob dpon 'jig rten pa'i shar/ rgyas pa la byang / dbang la zla gam gyi 'phel kha nub tu bstan nas slob dpon gsham gyi dbus su nub lta/ drag po la gru gsum gyi rtse lhor bstan nas slob dpon gsham gyi dbus su lho lta/ 'dur ma dang dbyangs ring rnams la so so'i gral dbyibs bzhin/ shā sa na'i sngags dbyibs la so so'i dbyangs ma 'chugs pa'i g.yas skor g.yon skor sogs gzhung bzhin byas nas sgrub khang la kha phyogs par/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma'i dbyangs rol mdos chen bzhin la mjug gi rol mo rgyun gyi gtor 'bul bzhin/ 'di'i g.yas 'gro g.yon 'gro la chos rje khu dbon gyi sku thog gi yi ge rnying ma las/ g.yas g.yon gnyis char la bkra shis kyi gom pa lnga re 'gro dgos par gsung / de lta de'i mtshon byed g.yas yaṃ g.yon yaṃ tsam las phyag len la mi 'dug kyang / byung na gom grwa pa gong bzhin cis kyang bya dgos so/

/nang du log nas tshogs la longs spyod/ lhag ma rjes chog gong bzhin la/ rten bzhugs kyi rjes su tshom bu la bskyed pa'i lha brgyad rang la bstim rten la ma brten pa'i sogs 'dra'o/ /de rnams kyis bzlog mdos bya tshul rgyas par bkod pa yin la/ rten mdos ni bsham/ thams cad gong bzhin la ri rab kyi rtser mgon po'i sku las mi nag mi dgos/ zor chas tshang ma dang sbyin sreg gi chas liṅga bsgral mchod sogs kyi gzhung rnams tshang ma mi dgos/ gser skyems nas bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar mdos gzhung bzhin nyams su blangs la tshogs phud phul tshar rjes nas la ye dhar phreng 'khor sogs bzlas nas/ brtan bzhugs spyi 'gre/ bye brag tu yang dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ye dharmā dang su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod cing me tog gtor/ rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya/ de 'dra ba lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ nyis brdeg 'phar mar bsgyur la/ mgon po mnga' gsol sh+lau ka gcig la srin gzugs ma'i dbyangs sogs mnga' gsol gang dgos thug chog deb bzhin btang nas mjug tu sum brdeg len can byas la bkra shis kyi tshig gang mang dang me tog gi char dbab pa'i mthar rol mo'i sgra rgya cher byas la tshogs la longs spyod pa man chad gong bzhin bya'o/ /mchod mdos la bsham tshang ma rten mdos bzhin la ri rab kyi rtse la mi nag 'god/ cho ga rten mdos bzhin byas pa'i mthar/ tshogs phud phul tshar ba'i rjes su dar mdung dang rol mo sogs mchod pa'i yo byad dang bcas ri rtse sogs sa dben zhing gtsang sar bskang gtor rnams dang chabs cig spyi bstabs kyi dbyangs rol gdan sa 'di nyid ltar na dus mdos la chen shar nub kyi gtor 'bul ltar 'bul/ gzhan du ni so so'i phyag len bzhin spyi bstabs rgyas pas phul/

tshogs la longs spyod pa man chad gong bzhin byas pas don tshang ngo / /yang bzlog mdos 'di la las mkhan ru 'dren bcas kyi 'chams sogs byed na mdos 'phen nyin gtor ma zhal bsgyur gyi bar byas la mdos gtor rnams 'chams rwar bsgrigs/ slob dpon drag chas can ban phur thogs pa rnga rol sogs dang lhan du bzhugs/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma'i drag bskul dang gnod sbyin yab yum gyi tshig rol dgu brdung gi rjes su sum brdeg tu bsgyur la/ mon bu pu tra'i dbyangs byed bskul rdzogs mtshams rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma tshig rol dgu brdung gi rjes la chem brdung byas la rnga chung pa med pa'i bud med/ de'i gzhug la rol mo bzhag nas rnga chung pa dang bcas pa'i skyes pa phub chung pa/ de rjes la rnga rol dang bcas dge slong sngags pa rdzogs rjes sgo ma nas bzung thon la lam 'gros nas ma gdong mas brgyad brdung gi rjes su rol mo sum brdeg len can byas la/ spyi bstabs dang kyai bos ma'i bskul man chad gong bzhin dang slob dpon sgo ma las mkhan rnams kyis rol mo dang bstun pa'i 'chams/ phyir 'gro ba'i tshe mdos gtor gyi rjes la bud med nas srin mo'i bar gong gi gral rim bzhin/ de nas rnga rol/ de nas slob dpon/ bskul pa dang 'phen pa rnams su ru 'dren sde bzhi so so'i gral rim/ sgo ma la las mkhan rnga rol gyi gdong du rol mo dang bstun pa'i 'chams dang / ru 'dren rnams bskul par slebs mtshams dang mdos gtor 'phen ring so so'i gnas su do rwa med pa'i rang rang gi 'chams ci rigs byas la tshur log la sgrub khang dang / nye bar rnga rol rkang gling bcom la bud med dge slong sngags pa rnams log 'chams kyi rol mo gcig cing 'chams rnams so so bzhin la bar ma chad par log rjes/ dzam med pa'i rol mo dgu brdung du bsgyur la/ sgo ma las mkhan rnams kyang log rjes dpon slob rnams kyi las bzhi'i bro brdung dang /

srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma rdzogs nas nang du log skyes pa rnams kyis lha rgyal sogs 'jig rten dang mthun pa ci rigs byas nas rnga chung pa rnams kyis sna drangs log 'chams kyis log go /des na dus mdos gzabs ma la dgos pa'i gser skyems dang spyan 'dren gyi ring skyes pa phub chem pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ bud med nag mo sha skal len pa bcas ma byung kyang chog liṅga dgug gzhug sogs bsgral mchod rnams slob dpon gyis bya chog pas drug brdung dang / bdun brdung gi 'chams slob dpon gyis kyang bya/ de nas tshogs la longs spyod man chad nyams su blangs na shin tu legs par sems so/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas rdo rje nag po chen po'i mdos zor gtso gyur gyi mdos kyi rnam gzhag gong ma rnams kyi yig cha bzhin nyams su len tshul sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs bla ma gong ma mang po'i phyag len la mdzad pa'i dbyangs rol 'chams sogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ji ltar 'jug tshul ma tshang ba med pa bstan zin to/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gong ma'i gsung rab/ khungs ma so so'i nas btus te phyogs gcig tu bkod pa dza yan+tu/ rtsa ba'i yi ge pa ni bsod nams 'od zer ro/ /'di la mchod pa'i sgeg dbyangs dang stangs stabs kyi rol dbyangs su grags shing dbyangs snying yin tshul phur pa'i dbyangs yig las bshad do/ ༈ o'o/ 'bol/ o'o/ cung zad bteg o'o/ 'o/ phra cang te 'jog oṃ/ sgra don bcu la 'jug pa las bkra shis kyi don la sbyar/ sku'o/ yi ye/ mgon no/ po'o/ rang bzhin dkar/ 'e/ cung zad bteg ra' ya/ rang bzhin/ pe'o ye'o wa/ 'bol te 'jog wa ya/ rang bzhin/ zhi'i mnan ye/ rang bzhin la mnan/ ba' 'a/ mjug cung zad bteg 'a/ la' ya' ya/ mnan/
